children: Solv Protocol plans a 159.32 million SOLV unlock in February 2027. The tokens are set to go to ecosystem, investor and team wallets. The amount equals 2.70% of the circulating supply.
The release adds to the amount of SOLV that could be sold. Once the tokens are unlocked, investors and team members can put their previously locked allocations up for sale.

title: Solv Protocol: Unlocks 159.32 Million SOLV - Feb 2027
